problem: Pet owners, especially in apartment complexes or urban neighborhoods, struggle to find compatible playdates for their dogs or cats, leading to missed socialization opportunities, bored pets, and increased stress for owners.
solution: A lightweight web app that lets local pet owners create, browse, and join pet playdate events. Users can filter by pet type, size, temperament, location, and time, and RSVP directly. The app stores data locally for privacy and uses simple sharing links for community distribution.
target_customers: Urban pet owners in apartments or condos
Pet sitters looking to offer group play sessions

competitors.name: Meetup
competitors.difference: General events platform; no pet‑specific filters or simple local storage model

competitors.name: BarkBuddy
competitors.difference: Dating‑style app for dogs; requires accounts and backend, whereas this is a zero‑backend static tool

features: Create a playdate with title, date, time, pet type, size, temperament tags
Browse nearby playdates with filter controls
Local storage persistence; no server required
Export/share event link as plain URL for community groups

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a premium add‑on for custom branding and QR‑code generation at $2.99 per month; free tier remains fully functional for basic scheduling.
monetization.free_tier: All core features remain free; premium adds branding removal and QR code export.

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free‑tier limits
launch_strategy: Publish repo on GitHub with GitHub Pages enabled
Share the link in local apartment community boards and pet‑owner Discord groups
Collect feedback for premium feature validation

marketing_content.tagline: Make every wag count – schedule pet playdates in a click.
marketing_content.social_post: 🐾 Tired of lonely pups in the city? MeetPetPlaydate Matcher lets you create and join local pet playdates instantly. No sign‑up, no fees – just fun. Try it now: https://yourusername.github.io/petplaydate-matcher

tests: Create a new playdate, fill all fields, click Save – the event appears in the list and persists after page reload.
Apply filter for 'Dog' and size 'Small' – only matching events are shown.
Click RSVP on an event – the button changes to 'Going' and the count updates.
next_improvements: Add optional Google Maps embed for location preview
